condition: recombinant DyP-loaded WT T=1 shell expressed in E. coli
method:
cryo-EM; CAVER pore analysis; 
APBS electrostatic analysis
notes:
Five-fold major pore; CAVER bottleneck diameter 7.3 Å. Significantly more open than the corresponding pore in 9BKX. Electrostatics are 
pH-dependent: exterior positive at pH 4.5 and neutral-to-negative at neutral pH; interior positive at low pH and negative-to-neutral at neutral pH.
